paper_title: Search for light scalar Dark Matter candidate with AURIGA detector
notes: AURIGA resonant-mass detector searches for moduli scalar DM. The paper constrains both de (coupling to photons / fine-structure constant alpha = ScalarPhoton) and dme (coupling to electron mass = ScalarElectron) on the same plot with identical limits. Limit reported is d_i <~ 1e-5 over mass range ~[850,950] Hz (mf = 3.6e-12 eV at 867 Hz). Numerical data only available from text/abstract; exclusion curve in Fig.5 not numerically tabulated. Frequency band 850-950 Hz corresponds to masses ~3.5e-12 to 3.9e-12 eV. Because the paper equally constrains ScalarPhoton (de) and ScalarElectron (dme), coupling-type assignment is ambiguous, hence confidence capped at 0.5. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.5, 3)) | read-vote N=3: ct=ScalarPhoton (3/3); medoid 1 of 2 curves (med pairwise 0.000 dex)
